`placed-window.skp` is generated by KetchUp's test script using the pinned MIT
OpenSKP 1.3.0 writer. It contains a red square with a square hole, a nested
translated placement, and a mirrored placement. Coordinates are inches.
Regenerate with `node scripts/test_skp_import.cjs --generate-fixture`.

`modern-triangle.skp` is a minimal ZIP/VFF container generated by the same
script. It carries one one-inch triangle in a `model.dat` TLV record.
